profile.summary:
Compliance isn’t about checking boxes. It’s about protecting systems, institutions, and people.

My career has been built inside highly regulated environments where precision, documentation integrity, and structured governance matter. From federal financial systems to global banking operations, I’ve operated where regulatory scrutiny is constant and control effectiveness is non-negotiable.

I began in banking operations, advancing into OFAC sanctions screening and high-volume payment compliance at BNY Mellon. There, I strengthened transaction controls, improved processing efficiency, and ensured regulator-ready documentation across complex payment ecosystems.

I later transitioned into federal service, where I now support governance, risk oversight, and structured financial control reporting within a regulated government environment. My work includes risk assessments, remediation tracking, audit readiness support, and executive dashboard reporting—translating policy into operational controls leaders can rely on.

Alongside my compliance career, I’ve served as Department Chair of Computer Science & IT and as an adjunct cybersecurity instructor. That academic leadership sharpened my ability to manage structured systems, align programs to standards, and lead with clarity in complex environments.

What defines me professionally:

• Governance-first mindset • Regulator-ready documentation discipline • Cross-functional control alignment • Risk visibility through structured reporting • Cybersecurity-informed compliance leadership

With dual master’s degrees in Cybersecurity and Financial Crime & Compliance and a PhD in Criminal Justice, I bridge policy, risk, technology, and operations.

If your organization values compliance as a strategic asset—not just a requirement—I welcome the conversation.

positions.title: Financial Management Analyst
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and maintained production Power BI dashboards and interactive reports using semantic models and DAX calculated measures to synthesize large-scale financial and operational datasets; tracked program performance metrics and improved forecasting accuracy by 26% for $3.5B+ strategic budget allocations.

Built and deployed custom PowerApps solutions integrated with Power BI, Excel, SharePoint lists, and SQL-based data sources to automate budget submission tracking, cash-flow forecasting, compliance checklists, and approval workflows; delivered real-time visibility and reduced manual processing time and errors in multi-million-dollar operations.

Partnered with senior DoD leadership to create executive briefing materials and data visualizations for budget submissions to Congress, OMB, and the President; translated complex datasets into clear narratives that directly influenced funding decisions and program strategy.

projects.title: OPIATE ADDICTION CRISIS IN THE UNITED STATES
projects.description: This research investigates how fentanyl has influenced drug trafficking trends and the corresponding response from law enforcement in New York State. It aims to explore the changes in drug trafficking pathways, organizational structures, and methods in this region since fentanyl's emergence and how state law enforcement has adjusted to this new challenge. The study uses a quantitative methodology, analyzing various data from law enforcement records, court documents, and state government reports. The focus is on fentanyl-related drug trafficking cases in New York State over five years. Methods include examining case records and analyzing trafficking patterns statistically. The study will assess fentanyl trafficking trends, including the amounts seized, locations of these seizures, and profiles of traffickers and users. It will also look at overdose death data to gauge fentanyl's public health impact. Various statistical methods will be applied to identify regional trends, relationships, and unusual patterns. This research is crucial as it sheds light on how the drug trafficking scenario is adapting to the introduction of fentanyl in New York State and assists law enforcement in formulating more effective strategies to address this issue. The link between the rise of fentanyl in the drug market and the significant increase in overdose deaths in recent years highlights the importance of this study.

projects.title: Senior Project
projects.description: For my Senior Project I developed a PowerPoint Presentation about OFAC. I had to work with my professor and management team to submit a proposal for my final project. I had to write a project plan, research paper and a PowerPoint Presentation discussing OFAC. Not many people know what OFAC is or what it means so I thought it would be a good idea to create something to help people get a basic understand of OFAC.

Conducted AML, KYC, and OFAC investigations for portfolios exceeding $500M+ in daily transactions, identifying financial crime risks and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Performed transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, EDD reviews, and investigative documentation aligned with U.S. and international regulations.

Enhanced operational efficiency, resulting in an 18% reduction in false positives and a 30% decrease in audit findings through control improvements.

Authored clear, defensible SAR narratives and supported remediation efforts during internal and external audits.

Collaborated with legal, audit, and risk teams to strengthen program governance and implement sustainable compliance enhancements.

experience.title: Senior Teller
experience.locationName: Rome, New York, United States · On-site
experience.description:
Managed high-volume financial transactions with accuracy and strong adherence to bank policies, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.

Provided exceptional customer service by resolving complex inquiries, identifying banking needs, and promoting products and services aligned with customer goals.

Oversaw daily branch cash operations, including vault management, drawer balancing, cash orders, and reconciliation activities to maintain compliance and minimize risk.

Monitored transactions for potential fraud, unusual patterns, or security concerns, escalating issues in alignment with AML/KYC/OFAC protocols.

Trained and supported new tellers by providing guidance on procedures, customer interaction, fraud prevention, and system navigation.

Assisted branch leadership with audits, branch compliance reviews, and corrective actions to strengthen operational integrity.

Maintained a consistent record of accuracy, reliability, and professionalism, contributing to strong branch performance and customer satisfaction.
